Simple Tree View - Selection

Source: vignettes/simple-tree-view-selection.Rmd
simple-tree-view-selection.Rmd

Original MUI X documentation: Simple Tree View - Selection. The examples of this page are written for R.

library(muiTreeView)
library(htmltools)

# Some functions of muiMaterial, muiCharts and reactRouter, used in all the examples of this page
pkg_items <- function() {
  list(
    TreeItem(
      itemId = "muiMaterial",
      label = "muiMaterial",
      TreeItem(itemId = "muiMaterial::Button", label = "Button()"),
      TreeItem(itemId = "muiMaterial::TextField", label = "TextField()"),
      TreeItem(itemId = "muiMaterial::Drawer", label = "Drawer()")
    ),
    TreeItem(
      itemId = "muiCharts",
      label = "muiCharts",
      TreeItem(itemId = "muiCharts::BarChart", label = "BarChart()"),
      TreeItem(itemId = "muiCharts::LineChart", label = "LineChart()")
    ),
    TreeItem(
      itemId = "reactRouter",
      label = "reactRouter",
      TreeItem(itemId = "reactRouter::RouterProvider", label = "RouterProvider()"),
      TreeItem(itemId = "reactRouter::Route", label = "Route()"),
      TreeItem(itemId = "reactRouter::NavLink", label = "NavLink()")
    )
  )
}

Single selection

By default, one item can be selected at a time: click on an item, or focus it and press Space. MUI docs

SimpleTreeView(pkg_items())

Multi-selection

Use multiSelect = TRUE to select several items: hold Ctrl (⌘ Command on macOS) while clicking, or Shift to select a range. MUI docs

SimpleTreeView(multiSelect = TRUE, pkg_items())

Disable selection

Use disableSelection = TRUE to prevent the selection of all items. MUI docs

SimpleTreeView(disableSelection = TRUE, pkg_items())

Checkbox selection

Use checkboxSelection = TRUE to render a checkbox next to each item. Combine it with multiSelect = TRUE to check several items. MUI docs

SimpleTreeView(checkboxSelection = TRUE, pkg_items())
SimpleTreeView(checkboxSelection = TRUE, multiSelect = TRUE, pkg_items())

Selectable items

Use disableSelection = TRUE on a TreeItem() to make only this item unselectable. Here, only the functions can be selected, not their packages. MUI docs

SimpleTreeView(
  checkboxSelection = TRUE,
  multiSelect = TRUE,
  defaultExpandedItems = list("muiCharts", "reactRouter"),
  TreeItem(
    itemId = "muiCharts",
    label = "muiCharts",
    disableSelection = TRUE,
    TreeItem(itemId = "muiCharts::BarChart", label = "BarChart()"),
    TreeItem(itemId = "muiCharts::LineChart", label = "LineChart()")
  ),
  TreeItem(
    itemId = "reactRouter",
    label = "reactRouter",
    disableSelection = TRUE,
    TreeItem(itemId = "reactRouter::RouterProvider", label = "RouterProvider()"),
    TreeItem(itemId = "reactRouter::Route", label = "Route()"),
    TreeItem(itemId = "reactRouter::NavLink", label = "NavLink()")
  )
)

Default selection

Use defaultSelectedItems to select items when the tree is created. With multiSelect = TRUE, give the ids in a list(). MUI docs

SimpleTreeView(
  multiSelect = TRUE,
  checkboxSelection = TRUE,
  defaultExpandedItems = list("muiCharts"),
  defaultSelectedItems = list("muiCharts::BarChart", "muiCharts::LineChart"),
  pkg_items()
)

Controlled selection

Use selectedItems with onSelectedItemsChange to control the selection from your app, for example from the Shiny server with renderReact(). See controlled state in Shiny. MUI docs

onSelectedItemsChange receives the ids of all the selected items. In Shiny, use onSelectedItemsChange = setInput("selected", 1) to get them in input$selected. On this page, a JS() function writes them below the tree:

div(
  SimpleTreeView(
    multiSelect = TRUE,
    checkboxSelection = TRUE,
    onSelectedItemsChange = JS(
      "(event, itemIds) => { document.getElementById('stv-selected').textContent = JSON.stringify(itemIds); }"
    ),
    pkg_items()
  ),
  tags$pre("Selected items: ", tags$span(id = "stv-selected", "[]"))
)
Selected items: 
[]

Track item selection change

Use onItemSelectionToggle to know which item was just selected or deselected. It receives the event, the item id and whether the item is now selected. MUI docs

div(
  SimpleTreeView(
    multiSelect = TRUE,
    checkboxSelection = TRUE,
    onItemSelectionToggle = JS(
      "(event, itemId, isSelected) => {
        document.getElementById('stv-toggle').textContent =
          itemId + (isSelected ? ' was selected' : ' was deselected');
      }"
    ),
    pkg_items()
  ),
  tags$pre(tags$span(id = "stv-toggle", "No item selection recorded"))
)
No item selection recorded

Automatic parents and children selection

With multiSelect = TRUE, use selectionPropagation to select the children of a selected parent (descendants = TRUE), and the parent when all its children are selected (parents = TRUE). Only the expanded items are considered by SimpleTreeView(). MUI docs

SimpleTreeView(
  multiSelect = TRUE,
  checkboxSelection = TRUE,
  defaultExpandedItems = list("muiMaterial", "muiCharts"),
  selectionPropagation = list(descendants = TRUE, parents = TRUE),
  pkg_items()
)

Imperative API

The MUI imperative API (apiRef, to select an item or read its selection status from JavaScript) relies on a React hook, which is not available from R. MUI docs

API
